title: Benedetto Fantini (DECODE 'Jantini'), Buda and Eger, to the Este court, 1517-1518 (ASMo, Ambasciatori, Ungheria b. 4, Fantini nos. 5-6; DECODE R1126, R1127; catalogue 156)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE R1126/R1127 metadata and images; Vestigia search found Fantini's whole file (V1846-V1852), all images fetched.
Sender identified as Benedetto Fantini (DECODE misreads 'Jantini'), Ferrarese agent in Ippolito d'Este's household; only nos. 5 and 6 contain cipher, and no decipherment is in the file.
Column transcription (upper sign / base stroke) of R1126 p. 1, 18 cipher lines, 581 columns.
Homophonic anneal (it-cinquecento 4-grams, unigram penalty) over p. 1 columns, with the frequent 7g/7y signs kept, merged, or treated as nulls: 6 restarts x 60k moves each.

Statistics: the three-column run 7 / g / m-with-b recurs 14 times and 7g or 7y occurs 45 times in 581 columns, too often for one letter per column; 7g and 7y behave like word signs. The unit of the cipher is unresolved.
Web search and the Bonzagni 1512 and Caprile 1519 Este-Hungary siblings for a printed decipherment or shared key: Bonzagni is a different alphabet, Caprile's 1519 key is itself not built.
Full column transcription of R1126 pp. 1-2 (43 lines, 1,370 columns) and R1127 (5 lines, 46 columns) by a subagent, with a sign inventory.
Caprile 1519 key from R1131 against its 1882 decipherment 5b (subagent): water-stained, alignment no better than shuffled controls.
Caprile R1134 pp. 4-5 checked for the interlinear decipherment the caprile1519 NOTES report: none; those pages are a second letter in clear with cipher insertions.

Caprile R1130 clear-bounded cipher segments aligned by hand with the 1882 decipherment 4c: the system is syllabic (upper consonant, base vowel 7 none / m e / n o, bracket-L = CV syllables); ~20 values, held-out 16/18 placed vs shuffled mean 8.1.

Syllabary anneal (it-cinquecento 5-grams, letter-distribution penalty) on 2,200 letters of 16th-c. Italian enciphered in the same structure: recovered nearly verbatim with bases 7/m/n seeded, and with 10% of signs corrupted.
Same syllabary anneal on R1126 (8 restarts x 150k moves, raw and with 7g/7y as ligatures): no Italian, restarts disagree, -2.37 per char vs -1.77 for the control's true key.
Caprile R1130 values seeded into the R1126 anneal: score falls from about -140 to -1,250; Fantini's key is not Caprile's.

outcome.fraction_read_source: no reading file; 0 of 1,416 cipher tokens given a value
outcome.notes: Attempted, closed unread. No key material: no decipherment, clear copy or printed text, and the only paired sibling key (Caprile 1519) does not fit. A control-validated ciphertext-only syllabary attack fails, so the unit or key family differs from the model.
